eval_expr builds Environment::new() — the minimal env registering native ops plus the three Sort-u axioms — so names beyond it (Nat.succ included) are unknown; the caption now says so.

`--verbose` is inert under `--json`: the cited line is the whole JSON arm and it passes only the obligation and the result, so `args.verbose` reaches nothing. The human arm one line below is the only reader (`print_human_result(.., args.verbose)`), where the tactic list prints unconditionally and verbose adds the temporal/induction shape, the tactic hint and the certificate size.

The minimal environment `clean eval` elaborates against is `Environment::new()` (built in `eval_expr` in crates/clean-cli/src/cmd_core.rs), and it is NOT empty: the cited line begins three `init_*` calls, run inside `crate::tc::with_deadline_suspended` (which only suspends a caller's deadline while they run), that register `sorry`, `trustedArith` and `trustedAy` through `init_polymorphic_axiom` (crates/clean-kernel/src/env/core/trust.rs — an implicit binder over `Sort u` returning that variable, i.e. `{a : Sort u} -> a`, an inhabitant of every type), followed by `ensure_native_reducers()`. No prelude is loaded, so any other name is unknown.

A declaration is credited only when its cited closure passes both legs. The imported-cone leg is ImportedConeVerdict::passed(allow_sorry) (reached through check_import_gate::gate_declaration): no refusal, no imported axiom, and every trust marker waived -- which happens only with allow_sorry (the command's --allow-sorry) and only for a marker whose head is `sorry` or `sorryAx` (SORRY_MARKERS); trustedArith/trustedAy markers and imported axioms are never waived. The local leg (cmd_project/declarations.rs would_credit and record_project_decl) waives only an ExplicitSorry/SyntheticSorry registration warning under allow_sorry, and a kernel check failure is decided before the sorry policy. So 'reaches no trust marker (a `sorry` only under `--allow-sorry`)' is what the code does; the previous wording ('reaches no `sorry` or trust marker') was false for every --allow-sorry run, and project_check_cli's project_check_descriptor_states_the_sorry_waiver_its_crediting_rule_applies now pins it.
